description:
This file defines the 'FunctionExpression' class in Twig's Node
ode ase for representing function call expressions within Twig's templating engine, including handling deprecations and compilation of function nodes.

classes.name:
Twig
ode
ode ase unctionexpression
classes.description: Represents a function call expression node in Twig's parsing tree, handles attributes like function name and callable, manages deprecation warnings, and provides compilation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FunctionExpression node with a TwigFunction or function name string, arguments, and line number. Handles assigning the function name and setting attributes, including deprecated ones.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for this function expression node, manages callable attribute, handles depcreation warnings, and prepares arguments for rendering.
